fields.title: Event / host / discover record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Partiful's own Next.js SSR JSON shape (__NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps). Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "event" mode records carry the full upstream pageProps verbatim (event, hosts, guest, similarEvents, passwordRequired). "host" mode emits one HOST_PROFILE record plus one HOST_EVENT record per published event (recordType discriminates; HOST_PROFILE carries a _warning if the host hasn't made an event list public). "discover" mode records carry one upstream trending-feed event verbatim, tagged with region/regionTitle.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL/ID that produced this record (or a region descriptor for discover mode).

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-nextdata, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, empty_input, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: HOST_PROFILE records only -- set when the host has not made a public event list available.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: "host" mode only -- HOST_PROFILE or HOST_EVENT. "discover" mode -- always DISCOVER_EVENT.

event.title: Event
event.description: "event" mode -- title, startDate/endDate, timezone, location/locationInfo, image, description, customFields, guest-count breakdown, passed through as-is.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: "event" mode -- list of host user objects, passed through as-is.

guest.title: Guest (viewer)
guest.description: "event" mode -- the requesting viewer's own RSVP status; always null for an anonymous/logged-out request.

similarEvents.title: Similar events
similarEvents.description: "event" mode -- other events Partiful suggests alongside this one, passed through as-is.

passwordRequired.title: Password required
passwordRequired.description: "event" mode -- true if the event is password-gated; some fields may be withheld by Partiful in that case.

user.title: User
user.description: "host" mode -- the organizer's public profile (name, photo, bio, socials), passed through as-is.

region.title: Region
region.description: "discover" mode -- which trending region this event was listed under (NYC, LA, SF).

regionTitle.title: Region title
regionTitle.description: "discover" mode -- Partiful's own display title for the region section.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across event / host / discover records.
